t: Brushless twin kit containing a combi drill and impact driver, with 2 x 3.0Ah batteries and charger. Combi drill with compact size for awkward drill/driving jobs, features 2-speed, metal-geared gearbox with variable speed trigger. Delivers up to 40Nm of hard torque. Impact driver with maximum power output up to 140Nm can be controlled with the aid of both variable speed control trigger and 2-speed assist mode. Both machines manufactured with XPT technology to prevent dust and water ingress when used in harsh weather conditions.
